notes: Two taḥwīl branches: the first ends at «عن هشام», the second («قال حدثنا أبي قال، حدثنا هشام») writes its own names; «عن أبيه، عن عائشة» is written once after them and is the shared tail
«أبي» in «قال حدثنا أبي» is the transmitter's father, a relation with no name; occurrence 2 because «أبي شيبة» in the first clause is the same word
«وألفاظهم متقاربة» is a wording remark: left out
